_what_this_is: Agency policy for the readiness verdict. Ships with the skeleton, like the glossary and the template — changing it is a config decision, not a code change.
_calibration_rule: Calibrate against account-lead judgment during the pilot (PRD §7, open-question precision). NEVER tune these against fixtures/northlight_01/answer_key.json — tuning against the exam makes the Tier-3 score meaningless.
_verdict_rule: ready_for_review requires BOTH conditions to hold; otherwise thin_input_return_to_client.
_min_fields_with_evidence: Of the 7 briefable fields (objectives, audiences, key_messages, deliverables, timeline, budget, mandatories), how many must carry at least one evidenced entry. Range 0-7.
_max_low_confidence_share: Maximum share of entries at confidence 'low' before the draft counts as thin. Full field coverage is not readiness if the coverage is mostly inference. Range 0-1.
_provenance: Set at Tier 0 as defensible defaults, not measured values. Reviewed by the account lead at Tier-0 sign-off; unmeasured until pilot weeks 2-4.
